name: 043.3 — the world kinds leave gob:overlay()
author: brodgar
description: Self-checking suite for task 043.3: gob:overlay() keeps only what is DRAWN at a gob — the three world kinds and the verb set that served them raise naming hafen.vr(), ov:offset means screen pixels and nothing else, and a hafen.vr() entity anchored to a gob is listed there read-only while the game's own overlays read exactly as before.
